methodology.title: Curated source-first AI intelligence brief
methodology.summary: This dataset is generated from public source feeds. Items are linked back to their original URLs, timestamped, and auto-categorized for triage rather than treated as infallible truth.
caveats: Feed freshness depends on source publication latency and RSS availability.
Threads coverage uses RSSHub adapters and may fail or lag if the upstream route changes.
Automatic categorization is heuristic and should be reviewed for decision-critical workflows.

news.title: Harvard’s $699 startup bootcamp offers AI avatars of its instructors
news.summary: In the HBS Foundry program, AI avatars provide feedback during practice pitches and board meetings.

news.title: Inherent, founded by DeepMind alumni, says its AI ‘teammate’ just outperformed Anthropic and OpenAI at replicating research
news.summary: Built by DeepMind alumni, British AI lab Inherent released Faraday, an AI agent whose ability to replicate scientific papers could be a stepping stone for innovation.

news.title: OpenAI says California should strengthen its AI safety bill
news.summary: OpenAI is calling for California to strengthen SB 53, an AI safety bill that the company previously opposed.

news.title: Frontier AI labs still won’t say how they’d contain a rogue model
news.summary: A new study finds leading AI labs have few publicly documented plans for containing rogue models, raising questions about preparedness as AI systems increasingly demonstrate unexpected and potentially dangerous behavior.

news.title: Anthropic’s Opus 4.6 is a smut-machine
news.summary: Anthropic forbids its Claude models from generating sexually explicit content. But a series of tests conducted by TechCrunch found that it didn't take much to get past the restriction.

news.title: Nvidia partners with data center developer Cloverleaf
news.summary: Nvidia continues to pour money into data center development — just as AI data centers bring lots of money into Nvidia.

news.title: Nvidia just showed that the harness, not the AI model, is now the real hero
news.summary: Nvidia research shows that AI agents can perform well, and not go off the deep end, through fine-tuning, even if the AI model isn't that great at the task.

news.title: Starcloud raises $250 million for orbital data centers as launch options dry up
news.summary: There's about to be a big fight to secure access to space.

news.title: The DOJ is investigating a16z. What does this mean for venture capital?
news.summary: Andreessen Horowitz has two partners sitting on the boards of companies that now compete with each other: Ben Horowitz at Databricks and Martin Casado at Fivetran. Nothing too scandalous on the surface, except the Department of Justice has reportedly been investigating the arrangement for almost a year, dusting off a 112-year-old antitrust law that’s rarely used against VCs.  Board conflicts aren’t exactly new, and these companies weren’t necessarily direct competitors when a16z first invested […]
authors: Theresa Loconsolo, Anthony Ha, Kirsten Korosec, Sean O'Kane

news.title: From Atari to EVE Online: Building on 15 Years of AI Research in Games
news.summary: Google DeepMind partners with game studios to prototype breakthrough AI gameplay.

news.title: AI data startup Micro1 reaches $500M gross run rate amid AI training boom
news.summary: Surging demand for AI training data is driving rapid growth for the startup and its rivals.

news.title: OpenAI is gaining on Anthropic with business users, new data indicates
news.summary: Businesses are willing to flop back and forth as each lab releases new models, volatility that should give both companies' investors pause about how "sticky" enterprise AI spending really is.
